title: Gloria S NDE 23143
content: I was told I had flown through the windshield of our truck, I had been driving, and it rolled. I was told I had my head buried in the sand, and I was not breathing. I remember none of this. I saw myself floating over my body, looking down at myself and my three children were leaning over my head area. I was lying face up. I can tell you what I was wearing and what they were wearing. There was no pain, I felt as though I were floating. No other memories, just what I have been told. Then waking up in excruciating pain in a medical center, which is all I can remember.

elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes Hovering above my body, looking straight down
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? No God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes That there is no pain in death
elements.After the NDE: change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes That there is no pain in death After the NDE
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes I've spoken with my children about this, really didn't get a reaction. Current husband has encouraged me to write this down so I have gotten info from them about the accident. My ex-husband had to revive me with mouth to mouth. I have told a couple of people and they said 'wow'.
